events.note: Georg Fengler arrived at the Port of Quebec City in 1924 on the SS Empress of France via Hamburg. He stated that he was a farmer who was heading to Waldersee, Manitoba to settle and take up farming. He cited his uncle Georg Frederick Fengler (I0767) as his employer, and stated that his mother Barbara (I0878) was living in Herrnstadt, Silesia at his time of travel. Georg arrived with $75 in cash.

events.place: Victoria General Hospital, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes: This Georg Fengler was a trapper and licensed guide.  Did not marry and there are no known children.
